summary:
Deploy: https://nasa-hackaton.vercel.app/

Deep-space missions to the Moon (Artemis) and Mars face severe communication latencies (up to 22 minutes one-way in Earth–Mars transit), solar blackouts, and extreme physiological stressors—microgravity fluid shifts, solar particle radiation spikes, cabin CO² pockets, and prolonged isolation.

AstraCare AI is an offline-first, autonomous onboard medical station and clinical decision-support platform designed for spacecraft and planetary habitats. It monitors 5 crew members continuously through a 6-pillar hybrid architecture uniting deterministic NASA flight-rule standards, gravity-aware individual adaptive baselines, an interactive 25-region 3D anatomical body model for localized pain reporting and targeted exams, and a 3-Layer Cross-Diagnosis Tree that separates external space weather (NASA DONKI), internal/cabin hazards, and psychophysiological strain. Powered by tamper-evident SHA-256 hash-chained store-and-forward synchronization aligned with NASA JPL Horizons mission delay profiles, AstraCare AI preserves auditable medical and psychological continuity when Earth cannot respond in real time.
details:
What the Project Does and How It Works

AstraCare AI serves as an onboard medical co-pilot and crew-readiness hub that remains fully functional even during complete Earth communication blackouts. The interface connects mission-wide oversight (a multi-crew triage roster and live vehicle environmental telemetry) with each astronaut's clinical workspace (vital signs, interactive 3D body scanner, differential diagnosis, mental health biofeedback, and a bilingual EN clinical assistant), built around six integrated pillars:

  1. Adaptive Individual Baseline: Rather than judging astronauts in microgravity solely against 1g Earth population averages, the engine tracks each crew member's rolling personal baseline (exponentially weighted moving average, robust median absolute deviation, and multivariate Mahalanobis distance) adjusted across gravitational phases 0g adaptation, chronic 0g cruise, 0.16g Lunar, and 0.38g Martian surface). A longitudinal quarantine threshold keeps anomalous days out of the baseline calculation so slow pathological drift is never learned as a "new normal."
    • Explainable Predictive Intelligence: Pairs unsupervised anomaly detection with a calibrated supervised classification ensemble across 26 variables (vitals, Cognition Test Battery reaction time, cumulative sleep deficit, personal envelope deviations, NASA DONKI activity level, reported symptoms, and 4 anatomical pain categories). Every prediction reports epistemic (model disagreement) plus aleatoric (sensor quality/SNR) uncertainty, local counterfactual feature attribution, and 24h–72h trajectory forecasts (heart rate, HRV, blood glucose, and anomaly risk).
      • Layer 1 — External Space Weather: Cross-checks onboard dosimetry and radiation-compatible symptoms (nausea, retinal light flashes, sudden fatigue with dose rise) against live NASA DONKI Solar Energetic Particles, M/X-class Solar Flares, and Radiation Belt Enhancements, recommending immediate shielded storm shelter (ALARA) and EVA suspension.
      • Layer 2 — Internal Physiological & Cabin Environment: Screens cardiac red flags, spacecraft life-support anomalies (CO²​ pockets, O², pressure, thermal), systemic infection, orthostatic/fluid shifts, nutritional deficits, renal stones, and musculoskeletal injuries.
      • Layer 3 — Psychophysiological & Behavioral Health (PsychGuard & Crew Vault): When acute external and physical causes are safely excluded—or when mood drops, cumulative sleep debt, cognitive reaction slowing, or behavioral distress signals appear—the system activates autonomous psychological countermeasures. It reassures the crew member with verified safe vitals and cabin readings, provides structured grounding (4-4-4-4 box breathing, 5-4-3-2-1 sensory grounding, Earth window anchoring, circadian lighting reset), weights 6 behavioral/autonomic dimensions against personal baselines, unlocks personalized Personal Crew Vault recovery stimuli (family messages, Earth nature audio, hobbies), and escalates immediately to the Earth Flight Surgeon if severe risk language or sustained extreme strain is detected.
  2. Spacecraft–Earth Store-and-Forward Continuity: During communication blackouts or deep-space latency windows, clinical snapshots, pain reports, and audit events are saved locally in an offline-first ledger sealed with a tamper-evident SHA-256 cryptographic hash chain. When link windows permit, queued packages synchronize with Mission Control while preserving integrity verification.
  3. Bilingual Clinical Assistant with Human-in-the-Loop Governance: A conversational text assistant (English and Portuguese) queries live mission telemetry, logs nutrition/hydration, updates context, and walks crew through NASA protocols. When external LLM connectivity is unavailable, it automatically runs on a deterministic local edge synthesizer. The AI never alters flight-rule thresholds and never escalates or resolves cases autonomously—every medical decision remains under human control.

Benefits and Expected Impact

  • Deep-Space Medical Autonomy: Safeguards astronaut health, cognitive readiness, and crew survival during communication delays and blackouts across Artemis lunar, Gateway, and Mars missions.
  • Lower Alert Fatigue: Prevents normal microgravity fluid shifts or post-exercise physiology from flooding crews with false alarms while staying sensitive to subtle personal deviations.
  • Whole-Mission Care (Body, Vehicle, Mind): Connects biometric sensors, spacecraft cabin life support, solar weather, 3D anatomical pain localization, and psychological resilience inside one transparent workflow.
  • Terrestrial Remote Care Transfer: Directly adaptable to offline-first telemedicine on Earth in Antarctic stations, submarines, maritime vessels, disaster zones, and remote rural or Indigenous health clinics.

Tools, Programming Languages, Hardware, and Software Used

  • Backend & Machine Learning: Python 3, FastAPI, Pydantic, Uvicorn, HTTPX, NumPy, Pandas, and scikit-learn (Isolation Forest, Random Forest, Histogram-Based Gradient Boosting with Platt sigmoid calibration, Bayesian Ridge regression, and Ledoit-Wolf shrunk covariance).
  • Frontend & 3D Visualization: JavaScript, React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Three.js / React Three Fiber / Drei (WebGL interactive 25-part anatomical body model in glTF/GLB format), Recharts, and Lucide icons.
  • Generative AI Integration: LangChain (langchain, langchain-core, langchain-google-genai) connected to Google Gemini (gemini-2.5-flash) with clinical tool-calling and a deterministic offline edge fallback.
  • 3D Pipeline, Development, Version Control & QA: Custom Python geometry processing script to segment a public-domain MakeHuman base mesh into 25 seamless selectable body regions; Git/GitHub paired with Claude and Claude Code for assisted software development, branch/commit management, and version control; and an automated Pytest verification suite.
